name: 决定系数 R² 计算器

map.由相关系数求决定系数: Coefficient of Determination from the Correlation Coefficient
map.输入相关系数 r，求决定系数 R²。: Enter the correlation coefficient r to get the coefficient of determination R².
map.📖 查看「由相关系数求决定系数使用指南」: 📖 View the "Coefficient of Determination from the Correlation Coefficient User Guide"
map.R² 表示被解释的变异比例。: R² is the proportion of variance explained.
map.R²=r²，回归中因变量变异被解释的比例。: R²=r², the proportion of variation in the dependent variable explained by the regression.
map.R² 高≠模型好（可能: A high R² does not mean a good model (it may
map.r=0.757 → R²=0.757²≈0.573，即约 57.3% 的 y 变: r=0.757 gives R²=0.757²≈0.573, i.e. about 57.3% of the variation in y is explained linearly by x and the rest is residual.
map.r=0.95：R²=0.9025，90% 变异被解释，拟合优良。: r=0.95 gives R²=0.9025, so 90% of the variation is explained and the fit is excellent.
map.R² 越大越好？: Is a larger R² always better?
map.训练集上 R² 随变量增多而增（即使无意义），需看调整 R² 或交叉验证防过拟合: On the training set R² rises as more predictors are added (even meaningless ones), so look at the adjusted R² or use cross-validation to avoid overfitting.
map.模型比\"均值预测\"还差时 R² 可为负，说明模型无效。: R² can be negative when the model performs worse than simply predicting the mean, which means the model is useless.
